steps.text: Start with one 15-oz can of pumpkin and add two eggs.
Mix this up until it is nice and fluffy.
Add 1/2 a tsp of salt, 1/2 a tsp of pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp of cinnamon, and 1/4 of a cup of packed brown sugar.
Add about a teaspoon or two of vanilla to your liking.
Add 1/4 of a cup of oil, 2 and 1/2 cups of flour, and 1 and 1/2 cups of milk.
Mix everything until combined, being careful not to overmix the batter.
Put some butter on your pan.
Make pancakes on the pan like you would any other pancake.
